normalize_image_tensor: normalize a torch tensor or numpy array image to 0-1 range with optional robust quantile clipping
put_text_on_image: put colored text with shadow on an opencv image at specified line and scale
smart_resize_image: resize an image with opencv while maintaining aspect ratio and optionally padding to target dimensions
torch2cv2_convert: convert a pytorch tensor or numpy array from CxHxW float32 to HxWxC uint8 BGR format
numpy2mp4_video: convert a numpy array of frames with shape T x H x W x 3 to an mp4 video file
